answer: One hand rings one quartz at a time; an epoch's horizon is twenty minutes wide. Forty timber licenses open per epoch: a claimant fells one marked timber, its grain matched to a block-seeded pattern, its quartz resonator ringing — one crystal, one license, one cut. Three strangers witness each cut, two each. Entry locks 70 POA, +50 per extra identity from one root: ten fakes lock 2,950 POA. One operator holds two licenses at most: ten fakes need five hands, ten cuts each epoch, thirty signatures, fifteen strangers. A missed cut burns 25; one quartz ringing at two mills voids both bonds.
